# Purchase Orders

Controls approved purchasing commitments and links business authorization to vendor delivery and invoice payment.

## Required fields
PO ID, vendor, requester, business owner/cost center/project, description/specification, quantity, unit/total price, taxes, currency, delivery/service period, contract/quotation reference, payment terms, approver, and status.

## Lifecycle
```text
Purchase need → quotation/contract basis → budget/authority → PO prepared → approval → sent/accepted → delivery/receiving → invoice matched → payment → close / cancel / amend
```

## Controls
Changes after approval require documented revision; invoice quantity/price should be checked against PO and receiving evidence; blanket/recurring PO use must have defined limits and validity.
